title: Chapter 561
text:
A series of notifications popped up on the interface.

[Blue Star Crisis] Completed!

[You have received 62 experience]

[Garton Star System Renown + 2]

[Blue Star – Six Nations Favorability + 1,500]

[Assassination Target] Completed!]

[You have received 1,210 experience]

[Garton Star System Renown + 30]

[Godora Camp Favorability + 1,000]

[You have received 1 Legendary Point]

Both missions were completed. Han Xiao looked at the notifications. His Renown in the Garton Star System was not low to begin with, and when the news spread, it would increase his Renown. After this battle, his Renown in the Garton Star System would probably increase to the level of [Famous Far and Wide], which meant that he would be a famous person in the Star Field.

This time, he had also received a new Legendary Point.

[Star System Legendary Point (Garton Star System): Battle of the Three Natural Disasters – You were surrounded by three Grade A Supers and did not lose in the end. You have proven your strength! This is a legendary story, enough to make anyone who knows of it feel surprised and doubtful. Everyone who knows of you will recognize your strength, and your story will be sung in the galaxy!]

The Star System Legendary Point had a wider range than the Planet Legendary Point and increased the percentage of the reward. The Planet Legendary Point was five percent, and the Star System Legendary Point was twelve percent. This was Han Xiao's first Star System Legendary Point.

Other than the mission rewards, a notification popped up on the NPC interface. There was a new option:

[Battle Campaign: Blue Star Defense Battle]

"What a surprise." Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

Only a more sensational battle would generate a Battle Campaign Instance Dungeon. Another similar one was [Battle Campaign: Power of the Dragon Emperor]. This meant that his battle with Dark-star had reached the level of generating an Instance Dungeon.

It was very easy to deal with the rewards, and it was completed very quickly. At this time, Godora spaceships descended from the sky and landed slowly. The commander walked over with a group of subordinates.

"Dark-star set up a space disruption device. We came too late, and they escaped. How is the situation here?"

As he spoke, the fleet commander subconsciously looked at the crater that had been blasted out by the main cannon, and his heart sank. He felt that the support mission might have failed, and Blue Star had suffered irreparable damage.

"The enemy didn't succeed …" Nagojin explained briefly. Han Xiao's actions played a key role. He focused on explaining the battle between Dark-star and Han Xiao.

Hearing this, Godora's commander and subordinates all looked at Han Xiao. Their expressions changed, and their faces were filled with disbelief.

Fighting against three Calamity Grades and the mothership's main cannon, this was too strong. Godora looked at the traces of battle around them and knew how intense the battle had been.

Godora's upper echelons had been anxiously waiting for the results. They were not worried about Blue Star but about Han Xiao's safety. As long as Han Xiao was alive, the information exchange could continue.

When they learned that Dark-star had sent three high-level combatants to deal with Black Star, the upper echelons' hearts sank. They thought that Dark-star had discovered that Black Star had stolen information, so they had taken action. However, Nagojin's report shocked the upper echelons. Black Star had not been defeated even when facing three high-level combatants. His opponents were not weaklings but three high-level combatants in the galaxy! In the end, he had even taken on the main cannon head-on. This level of strength shocked even the knowledgeable upper echelons of Godora.

Black Star's performance had already entered the ranks of the top combatants!

The Six Nations and the Sanctuary had suffered varying degrees of damage, and they were organizing people to deal with it. Godora's people had already arrived and were temporarily stationed there, worried that Dark-star would return and help clean up the mess at the same time.

There were dilapidated walls everywhere, flames blazing, and smoke rising in spirals. Many injured people were dug out from the rubble by the guards. They covered their bleeding wounds and screamed in pain. There were also residents who had lost their family members who were in a daze and sobbing. It was a tragic scene. Although Dark-star had been repelled, it had caused countless deaths, and the damage would forever remain in the hearts of the survivors.

Many of the survivors did not have time to grieve. They took the initiative to join the relief effort and contribute their strength.

Han Xiao rested for a while before getting up and walking toward the base. Along the way, the relief workers came and went hurriedly, constantly brushing past him. They were all rushing to save people and did not stop in front of him. However, when they passed by, these relief workers would spontaneously nod at Han Xiao with solemn respect and an indescribable gratitude on their faces.

After entering the base area, Hella came up to him and sized him up carefully. She hesitated for a while and said uncertainly, "Are you not injured?"

Aurora quickly interrupted. "Tell me if you are injured. I can treat you."

"I've seen many such small situations." Han Xiao waved his hand. His face was not red, and he was not panting at all.

"… It's good that you think you are fine." Hella paused and did not say much.

"Hehe, Big Sister was very worried about you just now." Aurora giggled.

Before Han Xiao could look over, Hella immediately explained, "If you died, we would not be able to live either."

Han Xiao rolled his eyes and said, "Helping me earlier is more useful than saying anything else."

Hella had never directly accepted Han Xiao's invitation before, but this time, she did not deny it and slowly said, "I will focus on training at the Dragon Emperor's place and become stronger as soon as possible."

"Me too." Aurora quickly raised her hand.

At this time, Bennett walked over from the side with a sorrowful expression.

"The outer area of the sanctuary is almost completely destroyed and can only be rebuilt. The Six Nations' losses are even greater. Many cities have been destroyed, and they are busy with disaster relief. They asked me to thank you for sending reinforcements on their behalf. Otherwise, the losses would have been even greater. According to preliminary estimates, twelve million people in Blue Star were killed, and the number of injured and disabled is probably a few times that number. "

"This result is already very good." Han Xiao shook his head.

From the beginning to the end, Dark-star's attack had actually only lasted a little more than ten minutes, but it had already caused tens of millions of casualties. If not for the mercenaries, Nagojin, and the players, the losses would have been even greater.

Godora's reinforcements had actually arrived very quickly. This was all thanks to the hyperdrive base station that Godora had set up early on. Otherwise, if Dark-star had been given enough time, it would not have been a matter of how many casualties there were. At that time, it would not even be possible to find a living person to count the losses.

The destruction of the cities was even more severe. They were basically in ruins, and it would take a long time to rebuild.

"This group of attackers is Dark-star?" Bennett asked.

Han Xiao nodded.

"Damn it …"

Bennett's expression was angry and helpless. Even if he knew who the enemy was, he had no way of dealing with them. He did not even have the right to talk to them. He could only swallow the bitter fruit and chew on his hatred.

"Don't worry, I will solve the problem of Dark-star. You don't have to worry." Han Xiao smiled.

After patting Bennett's shoulder, Han Xiao walked past the few of them and walked toward the central base. He only left a back view for Hella and the others to see.

They suddenly saw an illusion. The back view of Han Xiao when he left Blue Star and boarded the spaceship overlapped with the back view at this moment. It was as if this old acquaintance had unknowingly grown to a point where they could only look up to him.

…

After returning to his room, Han Xiao took a shower and changed his clothes. The battle just now had consumed a lot of energy. As soon as he relaxed, his stomach started to cramp from hunger. After eating more than twenty highly concentrated nutrition bars, he felt that he had regained some energy.

Knock, knock, knock!

Suddenly, there was a knock on the door. When the door opened, Herlous and a group of officers were standing outside.

Most of the mercenaries had gone to support the Six Nations and had just returned not long ago. As soon as they returned, they were shocked to hear about Han Xiao's battle results. They even thought that their captain had changed. After confirming it repeatedly, they accepted this fact and immediately ran over to visit Han Xiao.

As soon as the door opened, everyone rushed into the room.

"I heard that you defeated three Calamity Grades, and even the main cannon couldn't injure you?"

Herlous had a look of surprise. He looked at Han Xiao from head to toe and asked in confusion.

"When did you become so powerful? Why didn't I know about it? "

"You'll know when we have time."

"This … I think it's better not." Herlous trembled.

In the past, when they fought, it could still be called a sparring session. Now, it was purely a one-sided beating. He did not want to be tortured, so he could only win against his captain in cards.

Han Xiao smiled and turned to see Sylvia staring at him with sparkling eyes.

"Teacher, I want to learn this!"

"Get lost. You want to learn everything."

"No, I want to learn!"

"Don't even think about it. You can't learn this."

Sylvia's face drooped, and she mumbled, "Too much. How can you be like this …"

Beside her, Ginette winked and licked her lips.

"Captain, you're actually so strong. Let's … try it out someday?"

"Go find Harmon. I'm not interested." Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

Harmon was suddenly cued. He scratched his head and turned to look at Ginette. "Do you want to fight? I'm always up for it. "

"I'm not talking about a fight!" Ginette's face stiffened.

Bullsh * t, that's a fight … The Volga boss curled his lips.

The officers were noisy, and only Fu Ding smiled warmly. "Black Star, are you injured?"

"It's nothing serious."

Han Xiao nodded and asked, "Where did Aroshia go?"

Aroshia did not follow this group of officers to visit … ptui, to visit him.

"She expended too much energy and went to the reactor to recharge herself."

Han Xiao nodded. Aroshia was an energy body, and the reactor was her supply station.

The officers chattered for a while, and Han Xiao felt a headache coming on. He chased them out of the room and rested in his room.

There was no need for him to interfere in the disaster relief. Han Technician had more important things to do.

This battle had caused him to lose a large number of machines, and the most important thing was to reorganize the Mech Legion and restore it to its original size. The second thing was to advance to the Calamity Grade as soon as possible. He was currently level 136, and his combat strength was close to Grade A. He estimated that he would be able to enter the Calamity Grade once he reached level 140.

Level 140 was the time of his next Race Evolution, and the increase would be huge.

Coincidentally, his [Virtual Mechanic] class was currently level 11, and the upper limit was level 20. This meant that when he reached level 140, there would not be a Class Advancement Mission, only a Promotion Mission. He still had a [Mission Completion Card] in his hands, so he could directly advance.

However, although he was only four levels away from the Promotion Boundary, every level required a large amount of experience. From level 136 to level 140, he needed more than three billion experience.

The upper limit of Version 1.0 was level 60, and the upper limit of Version 2.0 was level 90. As more experience was required to level up, the upper limit would gradually decrease, and the players would need more time to level up.

At the beginning of the battle, Han Xiao had used all the experience he had saved to level up. If he wanted to earn three billion experience in a short time, he could only start from the players.

Godora was secretly preparing for the final battle, and Dark-star was kept in the dark. He had to quickly recover his combat strength before he could participate. [Godora's Ally] was also a Main Storyline.

"Looks like I need to update my skills and knowledges. It just so happens that I have enough funds in my account. I can buy Pugilist and Esper class knowledges, copy them, and resell them. I just need to change the price from money to experience. Oh right, I can also sell the dungeon I just got."

Han Xiao was already familiar with such methods, and he opened the forums to take a look at the situation of the players.

All sorts of posts appeared before his eyes, and the Blue Star section was almost entirely filled with posts about him. The forums had already exploded because of the battle earlier, and countless screenshots and videos showed the historic scene of Han Xiao facing the main cannon head-on. It was extremely shocking, and the players were extremely excited.

The trending list was once again dominated by him.

Han Xiao casually browsed through some of the posts, and the boasting made his scalp go numb, and goosebumps appeared all over his body.

So many posts from the players could be summed up in a few words:

Strong! Awesome! Shocking! Super cool! I'm in love!

The players who had already joined the Black Star Mercenary were the happiest. The stronger the faction leader, the more face they would have. Above them was the Dragon Emperor Ames. Just thinking about it made them feel that this faction had a bright future.

"This incident is an opportunity for the players to feel that the storyline of Blue Star has ended, and it's time for them to enter the galaxy …"

Furthermore, based on the needs of Godora and the responsibilities of a galactic news reporter, the events on Planet Aquamarine would be heavily publicized. If Godora's guess was correct, there would be many uninvited guests descending on Planet Aquamarine.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed … This was a good opportunity for the next stage of his plan!
